$description: Shared physics: the four material registers, the floating-layer fill and the four light behaviours. Registers are semantic roles, not content buckets; how many share a surface follows the roles present.

code.$description: Reading code uses the current world's sheet and legible syntax inks. Syntax colours distinguish code roles, not application status.

stock.$description: Matte, reflects, never emits. The resting register for sustained information (prose, evidence, tables, lists, records), not exclusive to it. Each world's stock tint is its color.paper.

raster.$description: Horizontal registration raster, confined to margins, plates and expression regions; never under reading text. Worlds choose their own pattern via world.material.raster.

emulsion.$description: Photographic/optical register: grain, halation on lit type, imperfect registration. Islands and plates. New art is never passed off as measured evidence.

anodised.$description: The anodised plane: machined and directional; command surfaces, chrome and technical apparatus. May carry short technical text; not a skin for every button.

phosphor.$description: Emitted state. Appears only where the system is holding a nameable state; decays when the state ends.

color.$description: The phosphor register's hue: the mode-resolved signal role, the one emission hue (world.illumination.emission aliases the same role).

floating.$description: A floating layer over content that scrolls beneath it.

fill.$description: Opacity of the layer's own ground fill; its text passes contrast with blur off.
Ground fill of navigation above decorative scenery.

field-opacity.$description: Visibility of the decorative discovery field behind readable controls and results.

glass-fill.$description: Ground fill of the discovery form and the furthest visible result cards; text stays fully opaque.

card-fill.$description: Near-solid ground fill of the centred discovery result; it yields progressively to glass-fill with distance.

glass-distance.$description: Distance in result seats at which discovery cards reach the same ground fill as the search form.

opacity.$description: Opacity of the world shadow over background content while a navigation layer holds attention.

modal-opacity.$description: Opacity of the metal veil behind a modal dialog, which keeps the page out of reach until the dialog closes.

art-held-opacity.$description: Artwork opacity while a bookmark is held by pointer or focus, revealing its lit substrate.

bloom-width.$description: Horizontal extent of the bookmark illumination field.

bloom-height.$description: Vertical extent of the bookmark illumination field.

bloom-origin-x.$description: Horizontal origin of light beneath bookmark artwork.

bloom-origin-y.$description: Vertical origin of light beneath bookmark artwork.

bloom-mid-stop.$description: Position of the midtone in the bookmark illumination field.

bloom-end-stop.$description: Position where the illumination returns to readable stock.

bloom-mid-strength.$description: World emission mixed into the bookmark bloom midtone.

media-edge-opacity.$description: Hairline reflection at the artwork boundary.

scrim.$description: Shadow support behind cinematic foreground text at the lower edge.

grain-opacity.$description: Subtle texture over the optical scene.

pointer-edge.$description: Visible edge of the optical pointer ring.

pointer-fill.$description: Translucent fill of the optical pointer ring.

pointer-blur.$description: Local diffusion through the optical pointer ring.

pointer-glow.$description: Soft halo around the optical pointer point.

scrim-mid.$description: Lower scene shading at the transition into open imagery.

scrim-mid-stop.$description: Lower viewport fraction at the middle shading stop.

scrim-clear-stop.$description: Lower viewport fraction where copy shading clears.

scrim-top.$description: Upper scene shading behind persistent navigation.

scrim-top-clear.$description: Upper viewport fraction where navigation shading clears.

bloom-intensity.$description: Radiance of the optical field bloom.

bloom-threshold.$description: Luminance threshold for the optical field bloom.

bloom-smoothing.$description: Luminance interval entering the optical field bloom.

bloom-radius.$description: Mixture of neighbouring bloom scales in the optical field.

exposure.$description: Exposure before optical field tone mapping.

vignette-offset.$description: Radial starting offset of the optical field vignette.

vignette-darkness.$description: Edge attenuation of the optical field vignette.

noise-opacity.$description: Soft-light grain contribution to the optical field.

ground.$description: Unlit ground beneath the supplied optical field, independent of interface colour mode.

ink.$description: Foreground on the dark optical field.

veil-opacity.$description: Even optical veil over temporary editorial film.

nav-opacity.$description: Top-edge protection for navigation over a film.

foot-opacity.$description: Local protection beneath readable film copy.

line-opacity.$description: Hairline tying the opening premise to its details.

secondary-opacity.$description: Subordinate opening text without losing readable contrast.

copy-shadow-offset.$description: Local copy shadow offset over a bright film crop.

copy-shadow-blur.$description: Tight copy protection without changing film illumination.

copy-shadow-opacity.$description: Copy protection strength against bright regions of the film.

veil-top.$description: Closed card veil strength at its top.

veil-bottom.$description: Closed card veil strength at its bottom.

scrim-start.$description: Position where the caption legibility scrim begins.

scrim-middle.$description: Position of the intermediate caption scrim stop.

scrim-end-opacity.$description: Caption scrim strength at the card foot.

scrim-rest.$description: Scrim strength retained by a closed card.

body-opacity.$description: Premise ink strength over directory artwork.

trail-opacity.$description: Opacity of each overlapping soft trail mask.

blur.$description: Optical defocus of inactive words during the focus sequence.

dim.$description: Inactive word opacity during the focus sequence.

side-opacity.$description: Opacity at the first neighbouring account.

far-opacity.$description: Minimum opacity of further decorative account previews.

angle.$description: Direction of light through a supporting scene card.

start.$description: Light share at the leading edge of a supporting scene card.

end.$description: Light share at the receding edge of a supporting scene card.

edge.$description: Resting edge light on a supporting scene card.

held-edge.$description: Edge light while a supporting scene card is held.

blur.$description: Scene diffusion through a supporting card.

saturation.$description: Colour retained through supporting scene glass.

mask-centre.$description: Horizontal centre of the decorative figure feather.

mask-solid.$description: Opaque inner share of the decorative figure feather.

mask-clear.$description: Outer transparent share of the decorative figure feather.

cell-fill-share.$description: Coverage of the sampled portrait colour beneath each character.

ink-share.$description: Maximum character ink coverage in the computational portrait.

bottom-fade.$description: Lower share of the portrait that dissolves into its surrounding surface.

reveal-feather.$description: Inner solid radius of a softly feathered reveal aperture.

reveal-deformation.$description: Bounded radial variation of the portrait reveal boundary; a click briefly expands it by twice this share.

veil-start.$description: Initial opacity of opening text protection.

veil-gain.$description: Additional opening text protection at full materialization.

ghost-opacity.$description: Maximum opacity of the non-reading secondary word.

edge.$description: Default visible edge of an optical plane.

blur.$description: Default backdrop diffusion of an optical plane.

saturation.$description: Default chroma retained through an optical plane.

illumination.$description: Key and raking light are material (they carry no meaning); emission and halation carry state.

key.$description: Default key light colour per mode, never beneath prose; the neutral base aliases it.

light.$description: Default key in light: warm daylight.

dark.$description: Default key in dark: a dimmer warm lamp.

key-angle.$description: Default key direction, clockwise from the top (315 is the upper left); the neutral base aliases it.

edge.$description: Catching edge of a lit plate; raking light reveals material at margins.

strength.$description: Default emission strength (0–1]; every world sets its own above 0.

spread.$description: Default bloom spread of state-bearing light around its element; worlds set world.illumination.emission-spread.

radius.$description: Bloom radius of halation around an emitter's lit core; only an emitter halates.
